title: Koi-Koi
pickField: Pick a field card to capture (two cards match).
turnYours: Your turn — pick a hand card to capture a field card.

decision.title: You completed a yaku! Koi-Koi or Shobu?

hint.koikoi_lowyaku: Call koi-koi to build a bigger yaku
hint.stop_secure: Call shobu to lock in your points

tutorial.field: These are the field cards. A played hand card captures a field card of the same month (flower). When two cards match, you choose which to take.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. Playing a card captures a same-month field card, then draws one card from the stock.
tutorial.info: Koi-Koi is a two-player capture game played with a 48-card hanafuda deck. Captured cards form 'yaku' (combinations). When a yaku completes you choose koi-koi (continue, doubling the stakes) or shobu (stop and score). First to the target score wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
